dialogues.speaker: Monroe
dialogues.text: Why don't you pray with us, my friend?

dialogues.speaker: Monroe
dialogues.text: On days like these, sisters in the Church will hold a prayer meeting.

dialogues.speaker: Monroe
dialogues.text: I've never missed a single meeting. Rather than being idle at home, joining the meeting is much more meaningful to me.

dialogues.speaker: Monroe
dialogues.text: Being pious is always a good thing, right?

dialogues.speaker: Monroe
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Barbatos shall bless those who are pious.

dialogues.speaker: Monroe
dialogues.text: *sigh* If this keeps up, I might have to considering moving to Springvale to wait it out...

dialogues.speaker: Monroe
dialogues.text: I believe that Lord Barbatos will understand. No matter where you pray from, you will receive an answer if your heart is pure.

dialogues.speaker: Monroe
dialogues.text: ...But it would still be best if we didn't have to leave, so please, Lord Barbatos, protect your pious people!
